entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: A treacherous naga zombie from Tarkir who epitomizes the decadent Sultai Brood; khan in the original timeline.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Allies of Sidisi who gave her necromantic powers and served her.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Venom-breathing dragon whose vizier Sidisi became.

entities.name: Nishang
entities.description: Former soldier from Kheru City raised as a sibsig by Sidisi, tricked into a pact.

entities.name: Qarsi Palace
entities.description: Site of a raid that gravely injured Sidisi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Event after which Silumgar's kingdom fell.

entities.name: Naga
entities.description: Serpent people kept in influence by Sidisi.

events.summary: In the original timeline Sidisi is the Sultai khan, aiming to gather all clans under her banner.
In the current timeline Sidisi is reduced to Silumgar's undead slave and vizier, secretly fermenting poison to kill him.
events.quote: Sidisi never became Khan and was reduced to one of

events.summary: After the Invasion Silumgar's kingdom falls and Sidisi, wounded in a raid on Qarsi Palace, retreats to the northern swamps.
events.quote: Silumgar's kingdom fell to the resurgent clans and Sidisi lost all of her political influence

events.summary: A rakshasa servant tricks Nishang, planting Sidisi's poison in his prosthetic; it destroys hundreds of sibsig at a ceremony.
events.quote: the poison spread through the ceremonial pool and destroyed hundreds of other sibsig

relations.quote: kept Sidisi at Silumgar's side as vizier
Her allegiance with the rakshasa provided her with incredible necromantic powers.
